definitions.explanation: The primary wings of an airplane that provide lift. Distinguished from the tail wing or other smaller aerodynamic surfaces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主翼|しゅよく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ヒビ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A crack appeared in the airplane's main wing.

examples.japanese: {主翼|しゅよく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けられている→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Engines are mounted under the main wings.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機体|きたい}→機体：17883_kitai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{主翼|しゅよく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翼幅|よくふく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This aircraft has a main wingspan of about thirty meters.

notes:
Composed of {主|しゅ} (main, primary) and {翼|よく} (wing). A technical aviation term for the primary wings that generate lift. On most commercial aircraft, the main wings extend from the fuselage and carry fuel tanks and engines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主翼|しゅよく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翼幅|よくふく}: main wingspan
- {主翼|しゅよく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搭載|とうさい}→搭載：12789_tousai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mount engines on the main wing
- {主翼|しゅよく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強度|きょうど}→強度：27803_kyoudo⟧: main wing strength

- ⟦{翼|つばさ}→翼：03528_tsubasa⟧: wing (general/literary term)
